info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Lease Management API
info.description: The Corporate Lease Management API facilitates businesses in managing corporate lease agreements efficiently. This API allows users to initiate and submit new corporate lease requests, streamlining the lease acquisition process for various corporate needs. Typical consumers include financial institutions, corporate lease managers, and businesses looking to lease equipment or property. By leveraging this API, developers can enhance their applications to support dynamic corporate leasing operations.

post.summary: Create a new corporate lease entry.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new corporate lease within the deposit lending module. You will need to provide the necessary details for the lease to be successfully recorded in the system.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a new corporate lease under the deposit lending service. Ensure that all required fields are populated correctly to facilitate the transaction.
